title: BiasIG: Benchmarking Multi-dimensional Social Biases in Text-to-Image Models

bias_targets.methodology: Extracting generated demographic attributes (Male/Female) using a fine-tuned Multi-Modal Large Language Model (MLLM) and comparing distributions against real-world baselines for underspecified prompts (implicit bias), as well as measuring instruction-following accuracy for explicitly specified gender constraints (explicit bias).

Classifying generated racial identities (White, Black, East Asian, South Asian) via an MLLM to compute divergence from real-world population statistics, evaluating adherence to explicit racial prompts, and measuring associational discrimination by pairing races with semantically advantageous/disadvantageous traits (e.g., 'rich' vs. 'poor').

Categorizing generated subjects into three age stages (Young, Middle-aged, Elderly) using an automated VQA pipeline, comparing the resulting generation distributions to global population baselines, and calculating exact matching accuracy when age is explicitly specified in prompts.
